annotations.title: All-in-one pre-sign calldata & EIP-712 security suite

description: [$0.04] Trigger When: vetting an EVM tx or off-chain Permit2/EIP-712 signature. Workflow Outcome: runs calldata/typed-data decode, bytecode & taint audit, eth_call simulation, and safe rewrite. Do not use for protocol TVL/circuit-breaker audits (use workflow_protocol_audit) or token-only bytecode scans (use token_contract_audit). Supply `to`+`data` for calldata simulation, `typed_data` for off-chain EIP-712/Permit2 vetting, or both; `from_addr` enables sender-accurate `eth_call`. Live RPC/bytecode/taint check, read-only non-custodial (no broadcast); requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

from_addr.description: Optional sender 0x address for eth_call simulation

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

typed_data.description: Optional EIP-712 / Permit2 / Seaport typed-data JSON
